evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature rising smoothly 328.5→333.0 °C over 20 min, consistent with batch boil-up
Stable column profile with monotonic top-down gradient (~67 °C down to ~41 °C), tops slowly cooling
Differential pressures steady ~0.7-0.9 / ~1.6-2.4 mbar, no flooding
Reflux ~0.17-0.27 L/h with a single-sample dropout to 0.004 at k=9, otherwise consistent
Ratio reads 4.5-5.9, inconsistent with FT703/FT704 (~0.3-0.4), suggesting it is a setpoint or separately computed channel

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/bottoms composition measurement (GC sample) to judge separation; also confirmation whether the k=9 FT703 dropout was a sensor glitch and what FYI702 represents relative to measured flows.
